description: Signs this machine in to Extract Insurance. The first call returns a link and a code: show both to the person and ask them to open the link, check the code and approve. Then call sign_in again: it waits for the approval and saves the key (shared with the extract-insurance CLI; it stops after 90 days without use). Already signed in: says as whom.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the approval on a later call (default 45).

name: sign_in
title: Sign in
